facts.fact: The bookstore occupies the former Grand Splendid theatre and preserves its dome, balconies and stage.
The bookshop opened in 2000 in the earlier theatre building.
An additional paid experience is described separately from ordinary bookstore access; current options must be checked.

title: Turismo Buenos Aires — El Ateneo Grand Splendid
